name: Amplitude
description: Monitor Amplitude projects and user access for product analytics compliance

config.setupInstructions:
1. Sign in to Amplitude as an Organization Admin.
2. Go to Settings > Organization > SCIM (requires the SCIM/SSO add-on on your plan).
3. Generate a SCIM API token and copy it (starts with scim_).
4. Paste the token above and select your data region (US or EU).
5. Note: SCIM endpoints require the SCIM add-on. If your plan does not include SCIM, the Employee Access check will return an actionable failure.
